fuse.name: Fuse
fuse.summary: Fuses all attacks into one bolt carrying their combined power × multiplier. Keeps its first attack's aim and element; wards stay separate.
fuse.art_note: Gold filaments converge into one white-hot needle beside an untouched teal shield.

code.python:
def fuse(bolts, battle):
    wards = [b for b in bolts if b["ward"]]
    attacks = [b for b in bolts if not b["ward"]]
    if not attacks:
        return wards
    power = max(1, attacks[0]["power"])
    return [{**attacks[0], "power": power, "mult": sum(b["power"] * b["mult"] for b in attacks) / power}] + wards

resonant-run.name: Resonant Run
resonant-run.summary: Consecutive bolts of the same element multiply their multipliers by ×1, ×2, ×3… A changed element restarts the streak.
resonant-run.art_note: Matching runes forming an increasingly bright chain, broken by a contrasting rune.

code.python:
def resonant_run(bolts, battle):
    out = []
    previous = None
    streak = 0
    for b in bolts:
        streak = streak + 1 if b["element"] == previous else 1
        previous = b["element"]
        out.append({**b, "mult": b["mult"] * streak})
    return out

duplex-core.summary: Final volleys containing both attacks and wards double all their multipliers.
duplex-core.art_note: Two orbiting cores, one shield-shaped and one needle-shaped, joined by a warm filament.

ecc-memory.name: ECC Memory
ecc-memory.flavor: It corrects its own mistakes before you notice them.

ember-heart.name: Ember Heart
ember-heart.art_note: A cracked obsidian heart with deep orange light in its seams.

ember-infection.name: Ember Infection
ember-infection.summary: From turn two of each fight, lose 1 Integrity at the start of every turn. A rest can cleanse this curse instead of healing.
ember-infection.flavor: A warmth that should not be there.
ember-infection.art_note: A black seed with tiny red embers growing through its shell.

feedback-loop.name: Feedback Loop
feedback-loop.summary: Every spell you have already cast this fight adds 2 to your bolts' multipliers. Cast small, then cast big.
feedback-loop.flavor: Output wired back into input. The Machine listened to itself and grew louder.

firewall.name: Firewall
firewall.flavor: Nothing gets in that you did not allow.

generator.name: Generator
generator.summary: Casting a spell of 3 or more cards draws a card.
generator.flavor: yield, and the next one is already waiting.

grimoire-page.name: Grimoire Page
grimoire-page.flavor: A page torn from a Maintainer's spellbook, still humming.

last-resort.name: Last Resort
last-resort.summary: At half Integrity or below before a cast, all bolt multipliers double.
last-resort.art_note: A half-broken red lantern with an oversized living flame.

leaking-capacitor.name: Leaking Capacitor
leaking-capacitor.summary: Lose 1 mana each turn (minimum 1 remains). A rest can cleanse this curse instead of healing.
leaking-capacitor.flavor: Every charge finds a way out.
leaking-capacitor.art_note: A chipped blue capacitor dripping dim luminous beads.

lens-of-types.name: Lens of Types
lens-of-types.summary: Hits on a weakness deal an extra 50% of their power.
lens-of-types.flavor: See what a thing really is, and where it breaks.

mana-capacitor.name: Mana Capacitor
mana-capacitor.flavor: It stores what the guardian could not spend.

memory-toll.name: Memory Toll
memory-toll.summary: Every cast attempt costs 1 extra mana, including fizzles. A rest can cleanse this curse instead of healing.
memory-toll.flavor: Even a mistake pays the gatekeeper.
memory-toll.art_note: A narrow iron gate collecting a small blue spark in its teeth.

overclocked-core.name: Overclocked Core
overclocked-core.flavor: Running hotter than it was ever rated for.

patient-engine.name: Patient Engine
patient-engine.summary: From turn three onward, all bolt multipliers triple.
patient-engine.flavor: It takes its time. Then it takes everything.
patient-engine.art_note: A three-stage clockwork chamber, its final segment blazing gold.

persistent-cache.name: Persistent Cache
persistent-cache.summary: Keep half your unspent block between turns, rounded down. New turn block is added afterward.
persistent-cache.art_note: A layered teal memory crystal with one bright inner shield left intact.

prismatic-dynamo.name: Prismatic Dynamo
prismatic-dynamo.summary: A final volley containing fire, frost and spark doubles every bolt's multiplier.
prismatic-dynamo.art_note: Three interlocked red, cyan and violet rings around a white core.

read-ahead-buffer.name: Read-Ahead Buffer
read-ahead-buffer.flavor: It reads the next card before you ask for it.

rearview-lens.name: Rearview Lens
rearview-lens.summary: Bolts aimed at the back double their multipliers.
rearview-lens.flavor: The safest enemy is usually the wrong one to ignore.
rearview-lens.art_note: A brass lens showing a bright distant silhouette behind a blurred foreground.

rime-crown.name: Rime Crown
rime-crown.summary: Frost bolts double their multipliers, including frost wards.
rime-crown.art_note: An asymmetric crown of translucent blue ice, silver roots inside.

riposte-clock.name: Riposte Clock
riposte-clock.summary: If your previous successful cast in this fight contained only wards, attack bolts triple their multipliers.
riposte-clock.art_note: A split clock face: a cyan shield on one half and a gold blade on the other.

runaway-coil.name: Runaway Coil
runaway-coil.summary: Every bolt's multiplier is doubled after your last shard — including everything your shards did to it.
runaway-coil.flavor: It was wound to store a little current. Nobody agreed on when it should stop.

runic-loom.name: Runic Loom
runic-loom.summary: Gain 4 block after each successful cast, even an empty volley. Fizzles do not count.
runic-loom.art_note: A small brass loom weaving thin golden spell trails into teal cloth.

rusted-lens.name: Rusted Lens
rusted-lens.summary: Attack damage is multiplied by 0.75. Wards are unaffected. A rest can cleanse this curse instead of healing.
rusted-lens.flavor: It makes every target look farther away.
rusted-lens.art_note: An amber lens clouded with branching rust at its rim.

second-grimoire.name: Second Grimoire
second-grimoire.summary: Bind a new, empty spell at once, exceeding the normal two-spell limit.
second-grimoire.flavor: Someone else's book, half burned. The empty pages still take ink.

small-batch.name: Small Batch
small-batch.summary: If one or two bolts survive the landing cap, double their multipliers. Fuse or trim a volley to qualify.
small-batch.art_note: A tiny brass vial containing two intensely bright motes.

storm-bottle.name: Storm Bottle
storm-bottle.art_note: A stoppered violet glass bottle holding a branching miniature thunderstorm.

swarm-banner.name: Swarm Banner
swarm-banner.summary: If at least eight bolts survive the landing cap, double all their multipliers. Pair with a wider aperture.
swarm-banner.art_note: A torn indigo pennant trailing a coordinated cloud of golden motes.

thread-pool.name: Thread Pool
thread-pool.flavor: Workers that were never joined, still waiting to be given something to do.

tree-shaker.name: Tree Shaker
tree-shaker.summary: Every bolt gains 1 power for each card your deck has fewer than 12.
tree-shaker.flavor: Whatever is never called gets shaken out, and what is left runs lighter.

tuning-fork.name: Tuning Fork
tuning-fork.summary: Every bolt gains 1 to its multiplier.
tuning-fork.flavor: Struck once at the Machine's founding, still humming the same note.

wardstone.name: Wardstone
wardstone.flavor: A wall is also a promise to strike later.
wardstone.art_note: A smooth teal stone projecting a curved translucent shield.

warm-cache.name: Warm Cache
warm-cache.summary: Draw 2 more cards on the first turn of every fight.
warm-cache.flavor: The first read is always the slow one. Not any more.

wider-aperture.name: Wider Aperture
wider-aperture.summary: Eight more bolts land before the rest fizzle.
wider-aperture.flavor: The lens the first Maintainers ground, before anyone thought to stop at sixteen.
